description: This file defines the CachedResult class used internally within the SCSSPHP compiler. It encapsulates the compilation result, parsed files, and resolved imports.

classes.name: CachedResult
classes.description: A class representing a cached result of a SCSS compilation, including the result object, parsed files, and import resolution data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a CachedResult with a CompilationResult, parsed files array, and resolved imports array.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the CompilationResult object stored within this cache.

methods.name: getParsedFiles
methods.description: Returns the array of parsed files with their modification timestamps.

methods.name: getResolvedImports
methods.description: Returns the list of resolved import entries.
